there are no absolute contraindications to combining HAART and antineoplas tic agents in patients with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection and cancer, but the potential for drug-drug interactions is substantial and warrants careful consideration.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the management of patients with HIV and cancer is a complex issue.
antineoplastic therapy should be administered to patients with HIV/AIDS in the same way as to patients without HIV/AIDS, but with the addition of antiretrovirus therapy.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of HAART is associated with an improved prognosis in patients with cancer, and therefore the benefits of HAART should be weighed against any potential drug-drug interactions between antiretovirals and antineoplastics.
